label: Bible Study
prompt: And he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin; The LORD is with you, while ye be with him; and if ye seek him, he will be _____ of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.
verse: And he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin; The LORD is with you, while ye be with him; and if ye seek him, he will be found of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.
note: The prophet Azariah's word to King Asa — a promise and a warning wrapped in one sentence.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: In what place therefore ye hear the sound of the _____, resort ye thither unto us: our God shall fight for us.
verse: In what place therefore ye hear the sound of the trumpet, resort ye thither unto us: our God shall fight for us.
note: Builders spread thin along the wall had one plan: hear the trumpet, run there — our God shall fight for us.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and smote the waters, and said, Where is the LORD God of Elijah? and when he also had smitten the waters, they _____ hither and thither: and Elisha went over.
verse: And he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and smote the waters, and said, Where is the LORD God of Elijah? and when he also had smitten the waters, they parted hither and thither: and Elisha went over.
note: Elisha struck the Jordan with Elijah's fallen mantle, and the waters parted — the prophet's job had passed to him.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of _____ fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
verse: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
note: Jesus explains his coming death in farm terms: a seed that refuses to die stays a lonely single seed.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Not _____ in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
verse: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
note: 'Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord' — Paul's whole work ethic in nine words.
